title: Canonical Transformation
description: A smooth, locally invertible transformation of canonical phase-space coordinates that preserves their Poisson-bracket structure. Time-dependent transformations are allowed, with the Hamiltonian transformed accordingly.

relations.note: Canonical changes of phase-space coordinates preserve the Liouville volume used in classical phase-space ensemble integrals.
A generating function can construct canonical coordinates in which the transformed Hamiltonian vanishes; the resulting condition is the Hamilton–Jacobi equation.
